name: San Jose
housing: San Jose renters live in apartment complexes and rented single-family homes; apartments in buildings of three or more units built before September 7, 1979 are covered by the city's Apartment Rent Ordinance.

localRules.text: San Jose apartments covered by the Apartment Rent Ordinance must be registered with the city's rent registry every year, and the landlord cannot raise rent until they are registered.

tenantHelp.name: City of San José Resources for Tenants
tenantHelp.what: city rent stabilization program and tenant help

climate: Test the air conditioning and check for cracks in walls; summers are warm and the area is prone to earthquakes.
fact: San Jose's rent registry records security deposits for covered apartments, along with rent increases.
